heroSummary: Madison Metropolitan School District started 4K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and Early Childhood on Tuesday, September 2, 2025; all students attended their regular schedule September 3. Fall Break was November 26–28, Winter Break was December 22–January 2, Spring Break was March 23–27, and the full final student day was June 10, 2026.
calendarNotes: The firstDay field uses September 2 because that is the first attendance date for 4K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and Early Childhood; all students follow the regular schedule September 3. Conference and professional-learning closures differ among elementary, middle, and high schools. Winter Break runs December 22-January 2 and students return January 5. On March 10, grade 11 takes the ACT while grades 9, 10, and 12 learn asynchronously or virtually. On April 15, grades 9 and 10 take the PreACT while grades 11 and 12 learn asynchronously or virtually. The June 10 final day is a full day and also hosts graduations for Shabazz, Innovative, and Capital High. Summer Semester runs June 22-July 31 and is separate from the regular school year.

allDatesCoverageNote: This list covers the official annual calendar from enrollment and pre-year staff dates through the regular school year and published Summer Semester window. It includes transition-grade and all-student openings, level-specific conferences and professional-learning closures, ACT/PreACT attendance splits, breaks, grading markers, graduations, and summer programming boundaries. It does not repeat weekly elementary/middle Monday early release or religious observances that are not closures.

customSections.label: September 2 Was a Transition-Group First Day
customSections.content: 4K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and Early Childhood attended September 2. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 began within the all-student regular schedule September 3.

customSections.label: ACT and PreACT Days Split High-School Attendance
customSections.content: These are not whole-district closure days. One group tests on campus while the other high-school grades learn asynchronously or virtually.

customSections.label: Summer Semester Is a Separate Program Window
customSections.content: Professional development is June 15–17, the Summer Semester all-staff day is June 18, and Juneteenth has no programming. Summer Semester begins June 22 and ends July 31; it is not an extension of the regular June 10 student year.

customSections.label: The Archived Source Is a Web Calendar
customSections.content: The official year archive is an MMSD web page. The two-page local PDF is a browser print with an empty second page, so no PDF download button is shown and the official web page remains the canonical source.

calendarFaqs.q: When did MMSD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: 4K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and Early Childhood started September 2, 2025. All students attended their regular schedule September 3.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MMSD Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. School resumed Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MMSD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran March 23–27, 2026. Students returned Monday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Who attended school on MMSD ACT day?
calendarFaqs.a: On March 10, grade 11 took the ACT in person, while grades 9, 10, and 12 had asynchronous or virtual learning.

calendarFaqs.q: Who attended school on MMSD PreACT day?
calendarFaqs.a: On April 15, grades 9 and 10 took the PreACT in person, while grades 11 and 12 had asynchronous or virtual learning.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of MMSD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day was a full day on Wednesday, June 10, 2026. It also ended quarter four and semester two.

calendarFaqs.q: Was the MMSD Summer Semester part of the regular school year?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Summer Semester was a separate program window from June 22 through July 31, following professional-development and all-staff preparation dates.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 13, 2026, against the official MMSD archive, the complete 2025–26 web calendar, and a visually rendered local print copy.
sourceReviewDetails: The local two-page PDF is a browser-generated print of the official web page; its second page is blank and it is not an independent MMSD PDF publication.
The staggered transition-group opening and all-student regular schedule were recorded separately.
ACT and PreACT days retain both the testing grades and asynchronous/virtual grades.
Level-specific conference and professional-learning closures were not generalized to all students.
The June 22–July 31 Summer Semester was preserved as a separate program window.
Religious observances were not converted into closures.
